title: An Open-Source Training Dataset for Foundation Models for Hyperparameter Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2605.23417v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Most hyperparameter optimization methods require extensive tuning of their own hyperparameters, often limiting their ability to generalize across different benchmark families. Foundation models for hyperparameter optimization that learn optimization principles from a large collection of optimization trajectories offer a promising alternative, with the potential to outperform manually designed methods across diverse problem classes. However, prior work as either relied on non-public datasets or on purely synthetic data, limiting reproducibility and generalization to real-world problems. As a result, progress in this area has been constrained by the lack of large-scale, real-world, publicly available pre-training data. translated_title: 面向超参数优化基础模型的开源训练数据集
translated_abstract: 大多数超参数优化方法需要对其自身的超参数进行大量调优，这往往限制了它们在不同基准测试族之间的泛化能力。从大量优化轨迹中学习优化原理的超参数优化基础模型提供了一种有前景的替代方案，有潜力在多样化的问题类别中超越人工设计的方法。然而，先前的工作要么依赖于非公开的数据集，要么依赖于纯合成数据，限制了可复现性以及对现实世界问题的泛化能力。因此，该领域的进展一直受到缺乏大规模、真实世界、公开可用的预训练数据的制约。我们提出了BBO-Pile，这是首个开源数据集，包含超过50万条优化轨迹，覆盖3,095个不同的超参数优化任务以及针对不同优化器的全局优化问题。
tldr: 该论文提出了BBO-Pile——首个面向超参数优化基础模型的开源训练数据集，包含超过50万条优化轨迹，覆盖3,095个不同的超参数优化任务和全局优化问题，解决了该领域缺乏大规模、真实世界公开预训练数据的瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces BBO-Pile, the first open-source training dataset for hyperparameter optimization foundation models, comprising over 500K optimization trajectories across 3,095 different HPO tasks and global optimization problems, addressing the lack of large-scale, real-world, publicly available pre-training data in this field.
